planner_declared_budget.scope: Independent count/limit checks of declared profiles; prediction semantics require separate model audit. Same cap does not imply equal actual work.

decision_diagnostics.decision_evidence_scope: All planner alternatives, scores, profiles and budgets remain in the original complete trace.

trace.model_assumption: Finite work worlds, not official probability.
trace.successor_policy: Original open_route rule on surviving FIXED ROOT tasks, using public feedback.
trace.terminal: Fixed-root-task route/optical/current-unknown proxy, not global remaining cost.
trace.new_discovery_scope: Real/hypothetical beliefs update normally; new service tasks enter next real window.

sampling.prior: N uniform 10..16; uniform channel subsets; independent uniform disk1800 position, radius1000..1500, half type, uniform heading.
sampling.approximation: Finite rejection support; known bearing likelihood is support-conditioned, not calibrated. Cleared-source geometry is integrated out.
sampling.count_formula: e_(N-D)(w_c)/C(20,N); equals proportional C(N,D)*w^(N-D) for equal unknown ledgers.
